query: I am evaluating an 82‑year‑old man. Among male Medicare beneficiaries aged 77–87 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of pneumonia, what is the total number of index admissions meeting these criteria in this dataset during study period?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_index_admissions
FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions a
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p
  ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd d
  ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses dd
  ON d.icd_code = dd.icd_code
  AND d.icd_version = dd.icd_version
WHERE p.gender = 'M'
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND a.admission_location LIKE '%EMERGENCY%'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND dd.long_title LIKE '%pneumonia%'
  AND (p.anchor_age + EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - p.anchor_year) BETWEEN 77 AND 87;
